title: Riskiest CLO Funds Are Flashing a Warning Sign: Credit Weekly

title: Kirkland Star Lawyer’s Antitrust Warning Sowed Seeds of His Own Exit
content: For the better part of 15 years at law firm Kirkland & Ellis, David Nemecek made a career out of exploiting loose lending agreements to perfect what would become a well-worn dance in the world of distressed corporate debt: Craft a debt overhaul too good for one set of a company’s creditors to pass up while leaving other creditors with scraps and buying precious time for the company’s private equity owners to avoid losses.

title: Blue Owl Sold Loans to Pensions, Own Insurance Asset Manager

title: Uncertainty Driving Private Credit Jitters: Cisar
content: Winnie Cisar, global head of credit strategy at CreditSights says lower return expectations, default rate cycles, and economic uncertainties are factoring into private credit anxiety. She spoke with Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield" after Blue Owl Capital said it will restrict withdrawals from one of its retail-focused private credit funds. (Source: Bloomberg)
